title: Provider Mode Selector Configuration
description: Draft configuration semantic instance for explicit provider-mode selection and proof honesty. The first assurance slice treats this as non-secret, non-generated, proof-relevant configuration that must preserve provider/environment separation.
purpose: Keep provider mode explicit so hermetic, local-composed, sandbox, live-external, production-shaped, and production-live claims are not upgraded by implication. If this configuration becomes generated in a later slice, it must declare generated-source lineage through sourceManifest before any readiness claim can depend on it.
aiGuidance: Provider mode is proof-relevant configuration. Never infer live-external readiness from environment name, generated reports, source paths, or route naming. Secret-bearing variants must not carry literal values, and generated variants must cite sourceManifest.
